text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I have something to discuss. I think you 
might already know, but――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A new release of the 'Tiara’s Journey' series, which 
compiles race footage of the Triple Tiara, is coming 
out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It’s, um... quite expensive, but... even so, I think 
it’ll be useful reference material for you too, 
Trainer! So――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-If you’re planning to buy it... could you maybe 
lend it to me later? My allowance isn’t nearly 
enough...!
